column1: # Pathogen ground truth for scripts/evaluate_run.py (tab-separated, one file per run).
# Excerpt from run expr2_05B_0.100A_4H_3G; a real file lists every read of the run.
# read_id : read name exactly as it appears in the run's FASTA/FASTQ (first word of the header)
# species : true species of the read, as "Genus species" (strain/subsp. parts are ignored).
#           A genus alone (e.g. "Enterobacter") accepts any species of that genus as correct.
#           Use "-" for a read that carries no pathogen (AMR spike, human, plasmid, ...):
#           any species called on it counts as a false positive.
# Reads not listed are left out of the evaluation. Lines starting with "#" are ignored.
